text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
The crown... was just beyond my reach.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To fail on the very first battle... what a disgrace.
Failing to meet everyone's expectations, how could I call myself "Emperor"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Utterly inexperienced, utterly powerless.
...How pathetic.

Though Symboli Rudolf showed an unusual hint of frustration,
the fire in her eyes had not yet gone out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—However, the dream itself
has not yet perished.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"There are still crowns to be won. This humiliation...
I will avenge it on that stage—the Nippon Derby."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I won't let our challenge end just yet.
You don't mind, do you?
And so, as planned, the next goal was set: the Japanese Derby!

"As we quickly shifted gears and held a meeting
to plan our pursuit of the remaining two crowns..."
(Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come in.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, President.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: Pardon me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you guys.
You came to watch just as promised, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, however...
I ran an utterly disgraceful race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How does it look... the current me? You must be disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: No, that's not...!

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
That was such a commanding run.
Truly worthy of the President...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
Running through proudly until the very end...
You were the very President I looked up to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
If so, allow me to make a vow right here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I shall grow even stronger from here on out.
Strong enough that you may lean on me without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
First, I apologize for failing to notice your troubles.
From now on, I will pay even closer attention to those around me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you want to gain strength, I'll instruct you. I won't let you carry any troubles on your own this time.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: I couldn't possibly trouble the President like that...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's no trouble at all.
In fact, taking care of you is my pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is why... won't you give me one more chance
to take you under my care?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I want you to believe in my strength.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
...Why do you go so far for me?
For someone like me, who can't do anything...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Because you are my dream itself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To create a world where every Umamusume can find happiness.
That is the mission I have placed upon myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And you aimed for the student council
to fulfill your own ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then, before that dream has even come true,
I cannot let her give up."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't say you can't do anything.
From here on out, I will carve out a path for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly care for me,
please, believe in me and follow me down this path."

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for being so weak-willed.
I'll... follow you anywhere, President... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please don't cry.
Thank you for making the decision.

It looks like the problem has been resolved.
Her ability to lead through "strength" once again proved worthy of an "Emperor."

However... from that "strength" of hers, I could
sense a grim resolve to shoulder everything alone.
Lost in thought, I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Pathetic.

Air Groove watched over the two of them,
a hint of frustration in her expression...
